title: Halving the Kalton-Roberts upper bound
abstract: Formalizes the paper-style Boolean-algebra theorem that every approximately additive real-valued set function is uniformly close to a finitely additive signed measure, proving the certified Kalton-Roberts constant bound below 19.838.

informal.KaltonRoberts.KR_constant_lt: Proves the headline certified bound that the Kalton-Roberts constant is strictly less than 9919/500, i.e. 19.838.
informal.KaltonRoberts.KR_constant_le_C₂: Proves the exact rational upper bound C₂ = 694198146664396294486127753 / 34994834677886019996000000 for the Kalton-Roberts constant.
informal.KaltonRoberts.set_algebra_bound_C₂: States the paper-style set-algebra formulation, where every approximately additive function on a Boolean subalgebra of sets is within C₂ times the error of a finitely additive signed measure.
